name: example-bergside-trade-terminal
title: Trading Terminal Dashboard
description: Dark cyber-terminal trading dashboard in the Matrix style: Space Mono throughout, near-black blue surfaces, dense three-column layout with watchlist and red/green sparklines, hand-drawn SVG price chart, open-orders blotter, order book with depth bars, and a live trade tape. One green interaction accent. Use when the brief mentions "trading terminal", "crypto dashboard", "order book", "market data", "exchange UI". Original page following the Matrix style of bergside/awesome-design-skills.

query.en: Build a dark terminal-style trading dashboard — watchlist with sparklines, live price chart, open orders, order book with depth bars, and a recent-trades tape in monospace type.
